Vanessa Ortiz: seeing multiple eu-west customers report chat requests hanging then timing out. anyone else seeing it?
Elliot Price: yeah dashboards show queue depth climbing. looks like autoscaler isn’t adding nodes.
Chloe Martin: is this an escalation?
Vanessa Ortiz: yes. creating SUP-4827 now + declaring incident.
Incident Bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-03-07-eu-west-timeouts (investigating)
Elliot Price: found quota cap set too low for shared pool. raising now.
Vanessa Ortiz: please drop updates in SUP-4827 so CS can message customers
